body:
**Parent epic:** #278

**Depends on:** none; first design task

## Outcome
A compact revision-bound source/reuse ledger for #278, not a fresh implementation baseline or code migration.

## Deliverables
- Reconcile main, parked integration #260 and stopped #277 against the immutable SHAs in #278. Record which file comes from which revision; never use whichever branch happens to be checked out.
- Inventory all 33 functions, fixed panel UIDs, shared power/reference circuitry, current board assignments and relevant open acceptance issues. Identify which changes would affect functions outside OSC.
- For circuitry, component evidence, generators, layouts/copper, harnesses, native tools and service labels, classify **reuse unchanged / adapt and reverify / evidence only / do not reuse** with reason and exact source. Shared multi-unit IC packages require indivisible package ownership or an explicit re-partition proposal; no orphan units or hidden package splits.
- Review #248/#249 and PR #261/#267 for component identities, 100-trimmer semantic inventory and annotation tooling. Reuse six per-OSC trimmer functions plus shared octave span without claiming native/new-geometry acceptance.
- Map prior #242 children and open PR lineage using the disposition matrix in #278. Keep native rejection results, resource/admission restrictions, incomplete warnings and original-group obligations intact. Do not re-run old experiments just to populate the ledger.
- Provide exact read-only source links for the next tasks, changed-input invalidation rules and a proposed future isolated branch/base; do not create that branch now.

## Acceptance
Every required function and prior unresolved requirement has a named owner; no accepted copper/evidence is silently discarded. Contradictory inherited readiness instructions are explicitly superseded. The ledger can be consumed without conversation history or local scratch files.

## Execution boundary
Planning deliverable under #278; **not started by issue creation**. Read #278, AGENTS.md and circuit/WORKFLOW.md before later authorized work. No production source/CAD changes, native campaigns, merge, fabrication, ordering or energization under the organization request. Preserve five OSC/all 33 functions/438 centres, canonical boards, decision.json and KEEP_K1402_INCUMBENT. Use exact source hashes and distinguish proposal, source/model evidence, native evidence and bench evidence. Missing checks are NOT RUN. Do not restart parked #242/E16 prompts or reopen completed finite-path/552-omission tasks. Keep pre-existing electrical and physical defects open.
title: [Design][01] Freeze architecture sources and map reusable work
